newsitem.title: MEXICO: Pemex production down in first eight months of '96.
newsitem.headline: Pemex production down in first eight months of '96.

text.p: The Mexican state oil monopoly Pemex said Tuesday that its refineries and natural gas and petrochemical units produced an average of 1,602,300 barrels of petroleum products per day in the first eight months of the year, down 1.9 percent from the same period last year.
Gasoline production averaged 500,900 barrels per day in the January-to-August period, up 1.6 percent compared to the same period last year.
Diesel fuels including sulphur-free diesel and boat fuel averaged 265,200 barrels per day, up 0.6 percent from 1995.
Kerosense and aviation fuel output averaged 71,200 barrels per day, down 14.7 percent from last year.
Fuel oil averaged 421,100 barrels per day, down 0.7 percent.
Petroleum products such as asphalt, solvents, greases, lubricants and other products averaged 83,600 barrels per day, but Pemex did not compare the figure to 1995 output.
Liquid gas production averaged 260,300 barrels per day, virtually equal to last year's production.
